WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS overall_avg
  FROM matched_fees
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS pair_avg
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY mktnote
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT p.pair_avg, o.overall_avg
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND p.pair_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND p.pair_avg > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS mean_pair_average_net_fee_rate,
       AVG(pair_avg - overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_overall_average
FROM qualifying;
